{{Quote|Accompanying Koon on aerial patrol of Cato Neimoidia's bridge cities, Jag (CT-55/11-9009) and CT-57/11-9048 received Order 66 and fired several shots from the wing cannons of the ARC-170 starfighters belonging to the 127th.|Moff Marcellin Wessel, in a report to Emperor Palpatine|<ref name="Order 66" />}}
'''CT-57/11-9048''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[127th Gunship Wing]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], they [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|fought]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], flying an [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighter]]. When [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was issued by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], CT-57/11-9048 and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jai'galaar (clone)|Jai'galaar]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] their [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], while they were escorting him on a patrol of the planet's [[Bridge city/Legends|bridge cities]].

==Biography==
[[File:PloKoonDeath-ROTS.png|thumb|left|200px|Plo Koon dies after being shot down by CT-57/11-9048 and Jag.]]
CT-57/11-9048 was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Order 66" /> One of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] who were bred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] for warfare,<ref name="DB Clone troopers" /> CT-57/11-9048 served as the [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] of<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|155|CT-57/11-9048}}</ref> [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jai'galaar (clone)|Jai'galaar]]&mdash;or Jag for short<ref name="Guide to Army">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref>&mdash;in the [[127th Gunship Wing]].<ref name="CSWE" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], they fought in a [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|battle]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Purse world/Legends|purse world]], serving under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]. During the battle, CT-57/11-9048 and Jag accompanied Koon on an aerial patrol of Cato Neimoidia's [[Bridge city/Legends|bridge cities]].<ref name="Order 66" />

The two clones flew [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]], while Koon piloted a [[Plo Koon's Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]]. As they proceeded with the patrol, the clones received a transmission from the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who ordered them to execute [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which dictated all clones to [[Death/Legends|kill]] their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] leaders. CT-57/11-9048 and Jag complied and shot down Koon's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], and it crashed into a clone training center, killing both the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]<ref name="Order 66" /> and 141 clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] stationed there.<ref name="Staging area">{{CSWECite|I|155|CT-8770, CT-8910}}</ref> [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Marcellin Wessel]] later filed a [[Casualty Report: Order 66|report]] on CT-57/11-9048 and Jag's actions to Palpatine, who had become the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the newly proclaimed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Order 66" />

==Personality and traits==
Like all of Jango Fett's clones, CT-57/11-9048 stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="DB Clone troopers" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Behind the scenes==
CT-57/11-9048 was first mentioned in the article "[[Order 66: Destroy All Jedi]]," written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 87|eighty-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Order 66" /> on [[April 17]], [[2006]].<ref name="Parent release date">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20060406.html|text=Inside ''Star Wars Insider'' #87}}</ref>
